failed_breakdown.definition: Earlier low AND close below its frozen prior-N-session support, within last three sessions; current close reclaims that fixed level, exceeds previous high, RSI and MACD histogram rise; RS20 rises over five observed synchronized sessions; confirmed higher lows or lower-wick rejection supports reclaim.

base_contraction.definition: The preceding N-session base spans at most 20% of its low; prior ten-session normalized ATR <=80% of earlier base normalized ATR and last-ten price range <=80% earlier base range; confirmed higher lows; current bullish close exceeds the frozen previous-five-session high. RS20 improves; RSI >=40 and MACD histogram rises.

controlled_pullback.definition: Before the pullback a close reclaimed EMA20 within preceding 15 sessions and advanced 3-15% from that reclaim to the pre-pullback high. Pullback low tests EMA20 or confirmed support within 0.5 ATR, contracts volume relative to preceding 20 sessions, establishes two-right-bar confirmed higher lows; current bullish close > previous high and EMA20, MACD histogram improves, RS20 positive.

common: Positive current volume >=1.5x prior-20-session average; bullish close; gain5<=8% and EMA20 extension<=2ATR; calendar-complete RS20/60/120 and historical lookback with no quote repairs or unexplained jumps in last200 observed bars; no invalid or zero-volume execution bar. Confirmed support minus0.25ATR, at least1.5ATR stop at signal close, <=8% distance; nearest overhead >=3-touch confirmed zone or prior126-session high target, never skip nearer major resistance to invent10% upside. Recheck10%/RR2/8% at next session open.

market_sector.core: Report regime and leave-target-out sector RS; no core gate because historical sector membership is unavailable.
market_sector.market_variant: TASI close >= EMA50 or EMA20 slope over five sessions nonnegative.
market_sector.sector_variant: Leave-target-out current-sector RS20 vs TASI >=0, >=3 other peers and >=80% active-peer coverage on every exact session; missing proxy blocks this variant.

neighborhoods: For each hypothesis test core; native parameter low/high; volume1.25/2.0; market gate; sector gate. One change at a time. All21 plus3 references, no best-parameter selection or tuning after outcomes.
momentum_reference: Close above EMA20,20-session stock return positive and RS20 positive, bullish current price and common volume/target/data/risk gates; no pattern-support gate.

walk_forward.fit: None; all parameters frozen. Expanding training prefix excludes purge plus prior test and post-test embargo labels. Known price history can warm causal indicators; never fit parameters or rank configurations on test returns. Fresh cash each fold; close at end.

promotion: No automatic promotion. All reused 2026 comparisons are descriptive. Require independently validated source history plus untouched post-registration observations, adequate samples, positive net expectancy under base/stress costs, stable folds/neighborhoods and risk-adjusted excess with multiplicity-aware uncertainty. Return INCONCLUSIVE when evidence is insufficient.

missed_opportunities.outcome: Observed maximum future daily High vs prior-session Close within20 sessions; not guaranteed fill or realizable profit. Require valid prior-session history and identify prior gate rejection; no hindsight labels used as entry features.
